schema.description: A successful response acknowledges the mutation only; background relocation completion is unverified, immediate reads may be stale, and no relocation job/status handle is documented. Presence of states destructively replaces the chain, resets creation defaults, ignores is_active, and leaves transitions referencing dropped states in place. Rename separately to avoid the documented chain-mode duplicate-name 500.
